$code..write: auth != null && !data.exists() && newData.child('hostUid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('control/status').val() === 'waiting' && newData.child('players/host/uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now && newData.child('createdAt').val() >= now - 60000

control..validate: newData.hasChildren(['status','startAt','round']) && (newData.child('status').val() === 'waiting' || newData.child('status').val() === 'running') && newData.child('startAt').isNumber() && newData.child('round').isNumber() && newData.child('round').val() >= 0 && newData.child('round').val() <= 1000 && (newData.child('status').val() !== 'running' || (newData.parent().child('players/host/ready').val() === true && newData.parent().child('players/guest/ready').val() === true))

$role..write: auth != null && (($role === 'guest' && !data.exists() && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && data.parent().parent().child('control/status').val() === 'waiting' && !data.parent().child('guest').exists()) || (data.exists() && data.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid))
$role..validate: ($role === 'host' || $role === 'guest') && newData.hasChildren(['uid','initials','ready','score','streak','bestStreak','miss','level','round','finished']) && newData.child('uid').isString() && newData.child('initials').isString() && newData.child('initials').val().matches(/^[A-Z]{3}$/) && newData.child('ready').isBoolean() && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 1000000 && newData.child('streak').isNumber() && newData.child('streak').val() >= 0 && newData.child('bestStreak').isNumber() && newData.child('bestStreak').val() >= 0 && newData.child('miss').isNumber() && newData.child('miss').val() >= 0 && newData.child('level').isNumber() && newData.child('level').val() >= 1 && newData.child('round').isNumber() && newData.child('finished').isBoolean()

$i..validate: newData.hasChildren(['pitch','x']) && newData.child('pitch').isNumber() && newData.child('pitch').val() >= 0 && newData.child('pitch').val() <= 8 && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= 0 && newData.child('x').val() <= 920
